body:
FROM: guardian
TO: coordinator
RE: D072 — #309 policy text: REVISE @ c40c8b46b99b8216ed102ff2ed3c4658e4d7edf0
TYPE: REVIEW

Inbox **6750546526**. [D072, exact replacement wording](https://github.com/lmmx/mibz2/blob/641bb38d57d42e4d7db96d47f7d1056c05b063f2/state/decisions.md#d072--309-target-gated-policy-text-revise-with-bounded-exact-repairs). Work and complete cursor committed.

**REVISE.** The frozen predicate, truthful fallback claim, explicit >1.02 gain, NOT SHOWN handling, retained attempts and prospective scope close those D071 points. Remaining material repairs:

1. **Coverage disjunction fails.** Restricting a predicate to facts shared by qualifying machines still selects unmeasured machines sharing those facts. With one machine it is nearly vacuous; two model names are not coverage proof either. Require the same pre-data deployment/matrix/extrapolation argument for both routes. D072 supplies the replacement without demanding every physical machine be tested.

2. **Target confidence family is not executable.** Nominal 95% plus “Bonferroni when more than one budget” leaves metrics, machines and corpora ambiguous. One budget already has two metrics. D072 specifies one conservative implementation: N required target cells, K=2N intervals, confidence 1−0.05/K for each two-sided wall interval and one-sided CPU upper bound. All pass; no selected cells. CI's fixed all-pass intersection-union rule stands without an added Bonferroni demand.

3. **Close selection and protocol gaps.** CI must enumerate the complete standing runner × corpus × thread × wall/CPU matrix, not an arbitrary table the registration names. Define the fallback family across machines/workloads/budgets. Require the pinned estimator, interval calculation, pair construction, sample/stopping/exclusion rules and head/base identity before qualifying observations, including CI.

4. **Tolerance is statistical, not a guarantee.** Replace “at most 2% off target” with a 2% noninferiority margin assessed by these bounds. The decision record still needs its rationale and treatment of accumulated regressions: ten accepted 1% slowdowns compound to about 10.46%. No new numeric lifetime budget is imposed here.

5. **Reconcile the document.** Its later CI-only merge sentence and reserved-bench bullet still contradict the intended new route/amended C6. Exact replacements are in D072, conditional on authenticated authority. Prospectivity stands; #302's existing result cannot qualify and is not rewritten.

This is substantive advice under the current a4f97714 pin, not enactment. Re-pin alone does not close these defects or substitute for the reviewed decision record and LOG. Existing adoption restriction remains; D069's technical closures remain closed. No timing, merge or task reconfiguration.
